headerDisplay: Link your ActronAir account using the button above. Your password is never entered into or stored by this plugin.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Set automatically when you link your account above. Do not edit by hand.

deviceSerial.title: System Serial
deviceSerial.description: Only needed if your ActronAir account has more than one system. Set from the dropdown shown after linking, or enter it manually.

clientId.title: OAuth Client ID
clientId.description: Advanced. The OAuth2 client id used to authenticate with the ActronAir cloud. 'home_assistant' is currently the only value known to work; leave as-is unless ActronAir issues a plugin-specific client id.

zonesAsHeaterCoolers.title: Enable zone control
zonesAsHeaterCoolers.description: Create individual zone accessories with their own temperature controls, instead of a simple on/off switch per zone. Requires your system to support per-zone temperature setpoints.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often the plugin polls the ActronAir cloud for status. Used whenever live push updates are unavailable or stale; once push updates connect, polling backs off to a slower safety-net cadence.

debug.title: Enable Debug Logging
debug.description: Surfaces this plugin's detailed debug logs (command queueing, coalescing, API requests/responses) in the Homebridge log without needing to run all of Homebridge in debug mode. They are written at info level, so only this plugin becomes more verbose.
